I thought it would be cool to start a subverse for my profession!

Everybody thinks that us tow truck drivers are the scum of the earth, but I HATE that stigma! My company was started by my father back in 1991, and he has built his business off of customer service and a top notch appearance. We pride ourselves in how clean we keep our trucks, the comfort of our showroom, and the professionalism of our drivers. We are a part of the TRPC (Towing and Recovery Professionals of Connecticut), and my father is the chairman of the training committee. TRPC training is required in the state of Connecticut for anyone that wants to tow for the local or state police departments. Regardless of what is required, we believe that everyone should be trained to complete the job in a professional manner, and keep everybody involved safe!

The good news is, we are not alone in this crusade! There are TONS of towing companies that share our values, though we are often grouped in with the "fly-by-night" towing companies that don't share the same level of professionalism.

I've created this subverse for people within my profession to come share their experiences, and post pictures and content that they would like to share with people outside of our industry!

I hope this takes off, and I hope to see plenty of people here, because I LOVE my job, and I want to see other people that have an appreciation for what we do every day when we come to save YOU!
